current_role: US Special Envoy to the Middle East and Special Envoy for Peace Missions (since 2025); founder of the Witkoff Group
summary: Steve Witkoff is a New York and Miami real estate developer and Trump's friend since a 1986 deal. As special envoy since 2025 he has led talks over Gaza, Iran and Russia's war in Ukraine, criticized for perceived pro-Russian positions; his family's business ties to Gulf governments, including through the Trump-linked crypto firm World Liberty Financial, have raised conflict-of-interest concerns.
